Liam Chen: FYI — Aisha Khan (Applied ML) final loop confirmed for Tue 10/07, 10:00–12:00 PT. Shes flying in from NYC and asked about a few things. Can ops/HR advise on travel + accessibility?
Meera Patel: Thanks Liam. Do we have approved travel stipend and hotel nights for this level? Also need a quiet interview room + accessible tech setup.
Diego Rios: I can reserve a quiet room on floor 3. Will test Zoom + shared whiteboard beforehand. Any special AV needs?
Liam Chen: She mentioned needing screen-reader friendly materials and prefers docs over images. Also dietary: vegetarian. Travel: requested pickup from airport if possible.
Katie O'Neil: Travel stipend approved up to $400 for this role. Expense code is `RD-HIR-2026`. I can prep the reimbursement + taxi voucher. :white_check_mark:
RecruiterBot: Candidate profile updated. Travel approved: $350. Hotel nights: 1. Accessibility note flag added to candidate profile. Auto-sending orientation checklist to candidate.
Meera Patel: Perfect. Diego — can you ensure the shared whiteboard contains ALT text versions of any diagrams? Also, I'll be onsite to greet her.
Diego Rios: Yep — will add alt text and a plain-text summary in the meeting doc. Planning to run a quick runbook test at 9:15am PT.
Liam Chen: Calendar invite needs: Zoom link, directions to 3rd floor, parking validation code, and the expense form link. I'll draft. Can Office Ops confirm parking spot and airport pickup? @Office Ops
Office Ops: Reserved one visitor parking spot (Lot B) and arranged a 12:15pm airport pickup. Driver details will be PMed to Liam. :truck:
Liam Chen: Thanks. Draft schedule below — please confirm and I'll send invites + candidate packet.

10:00 - 10:20 Intro + role overview (Meera)
10:25 - 11:10 System design (Diego)
11:15 - 11:45 Take-home debrief + hiring manager Qs (Meera)
11:50 - 12:00 Wrap + next steps (Liam)

Katie O'Neil: Looks good. I'll attach the expense form and scanning instructions for receipts. Also adding a note about vegetarian options for the 11:00 lunch.
Meera Patel: One more — please include a phone contact for the driver and a backup Zoom link in case the office WiFi is flaky.
Diego Rios: Will do backup link and test cellular hot-spot. I'll post the test results here at 9:20am PT.
RecruiterBot: Calendar invite created and sent to interviewers + candidate. Candidate packet (travel + accessibility info) emailed to Aisha. :email:
Liam Chen: Great work team — thanks. If anything changes, reply here and I'll update the invites.
